verdict.rationale: Foreign-qualification filing is a fair question for a registered-agent and business-filing provider, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence on it: the first-party site returned a Cloudflare challenge and nothing was fetched, and the only community item comments on the company's SEO, not its filing services.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
